title: How a P-Trap Preserves the Sewer Gas Barrier
description: The P-trap is a fundamental drainage component designed to hold a standing liquid seal after every fixture discharge. This standing water forms an airtight physical barrier between the drainage pipe network and indoor air. As waste water enters the sink basin, gravity forces it down through the dip of the trap and out toward the main drain line. Once flow stops, a residual volume of clean water remains trapped in the low bend. This simple fluid barrier prevents sewer odors, harmful gases, and pests from entering through the drain opening.
